visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large giraffe with distinctive brown hexagonal patches and a long neck walks slowly from left to right along a wire-mesh fence in an outdoor enclosure. The background consists of dense green trees and a concrete wall. Bright, direct sunlight casts strong shadows on the ground and the giraffe's body. (2) The camera cuts to a closer medium shot of the giraffe standing near a wooden fence and a shaded structure with a thatched roof. The giraffe remains mostly still, occasionally moving its head. The lighting is still bright, highlighting the texture of its fur. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the giraffe's head as it chews continuously. Its eyes are dark and prominent, and its mouth moves in a rhythmic grinding motion. A tall blade of grass is visible in the background. (4) The scene returns to a wide shot of the giraffe walking back toward the shaded area near the concrete wall. Yellow text overlays remain constant at the top and bottom of the frame throughout all phases.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 你有所不知的長頸鹿陰影. [Logo]: ANIMAL SUNDAY 動物星天頻道. [Slogan]: 深入探索：長頸鹿. [Subtitle]: 星期天配音是對的. (2) [Subtitle]: 長頸鹿是控制體溫的高手. (3) [Subtitle]: 這隻長頸鹿正在陰影下乘涼. (4) [Subtitle]: 好讓體溫能夠降低一些. (5) [Subtitle]: 臺灣的夏天 實在是炎熱極了. (6) [Subtitle]: 有時園方也會在空氣中噴上一點濕氣. (7) [Subtitle]: 來讓牠們更舒服一些. (8) [Subtitle]: 這些正在陰影下乘涼. (9) [Subtitle]: 享受濕氣的長頸鹿. (10) [Subtitle]: 學者們稱為陰濕鹿.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A zoo enclosure featuring a tall wire-mesh fence, dense green foliage and trees in the background, a concrete wall, a shaded thatched-roof structure, and a dirt/grass ground area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic and clear male voiceover in Traditional Chinese. The tone is informative yet slightly exaggerated, typical of educational parody. Background music (BGM) is a light, mid-tempo acoustic track featuring bright guitar strumming and simple piano chords. A subtle 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator finishes his first sentence. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates the transition as the narrator explains the giraffe's cooling behavior. The BGM remains constant, providing a cheerful, stable rhythmic bed. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and well-enunciated. (3) As the narrator delivers the punchline regarding the pun '陰濕鹿', his pitch rises slightly for emphasis, followed by a playful, twinkling sound effect. The BGM swells slightly in volume during the brief pause before the final sentence, maintaining high spectral brightness and clarity until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide humorous entertainment disguised as a nature documentary. The video uses footage of a giraffe in a zoo to set up a linguistic pun based on the animal's behavior of seeking shade and moisture in the Taiwanese summer.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video mimics the style of an official nature documentary (Animal Planet parody) to deliver a short-form joke/pun.
